item.mmblocks.block_visualizer.desc: Hold in hand to see all invisible blocks
item.mmblocks.playerfinder.desc: Invisible, passable block. Powers connected network while a player is inside.
item.mmblocks.one_time_playerfinder.desc: Invisible, single-use detector. Emits a redstone signal and destroys itself once triggered.
item.mmblocks.wireless_redstone_sign.des: Place two or more signs with the same text. When one receives a redstone signal, all signs on the same channel emit a 15-strength signal.
